term: well-foundedness and anti-brute-root premises: thinker-local versus global
resolution: The global sense (DEF-BRUTE-ROOT-RELATIVE-GROUNDING) takes WellFounded (m.grounds w) over the whole candidate carrier (the well-foundedness that BRUTE-ROOT-DISJUNCTION negates in its escape horn) and EveryContingentGroundedAt for every actual contingent concretum (the premise that, with that well-foundedness, closes the root horn in the unregistered lemma necessaryConcreteOfGroundedContingents). The thinker-local sense (DEF-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUND-ANCESTRY) is that of STMT-COGITO-THINKER-GROUNDING-ACCESSIBLE (only Acc of the actual-concrete restriction of grounds at each bearer of an occurring thought) and STMT-COGITO-THINKER-ANCESTRY-GROUNDED (grounding only for contingent actual concrete ground-ancestors of such a bearer). Every premise and conclusion of COGITO-ANCESTRY-ROOT-FORK and COGITO-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-ANCESTOR uses the local sense only, and no step passes to the global sense. STMT-COGITO-ANCESTRY-CONTROLS states both senses and relates them only by the proved implication global → local and by one model of local ∧ ¬global, which certifies that the local premises are strictly weaker. In both senses 'grounds' is the Profile's world-local relation: it is not Ontic.Causes, not temporal succession and not Aquinas's per se efficient link, and a root of it may have a non-concrete or unmodelled explanation. Acc of the restricted relation leaves cycles or regresses through non-concrete or absent grounds unconstrained, even below the bearer.
